title: Biomarker analysis and kinetic simulations for a CRISPR/Cas13a-CHA sepsis biosensing system
description:
Code, inputs and results reproducing the computational analyses of the CRISPR/Cas13a-CHA sepsis biosensor described in the associated article.

Two independent analyses are covered: (1) selection of the hsa-miR-150-5p / hsa-miR-486-5p biomarker pair from NCBI GEO series GSE134358, with leak-free cross-validation and nested cross-validation for hyper-parameter search; (2) kinetic modelling of the catalytic hairpin assembly circuit, comprising the rate-constant calculations, the strand-displacement ODE model, and the coupled Cas13a-CHA model behind manuscript Figure 7.

The repository includes a download script for the GEO inputs, so the preprocessing chain runs end to end from the public data. Software is released under the MIT licence; the data and result files under CC BY 4.0. Files derived from GEO series GSE134358 remain subject to the terms of that original deposit. See the LICENSE file for details.
